summary.notes: First RP spec for exterior deck surfaces. Assessment-first workflow properly integrated. Coating compatibility rules correctly enforced. All cross-file threading validated. 2 major warnings relate to compounding delamination risk documentation and multi-layer stripping rate uncertainty.

rule_1_tsk_sop_to_production.notes: All 43 TSK_DKRP_ IDs in sop_modules.json have matching rates in production.json.

rule_2_itm_in_variants.notes: All 4 paintable items appear in at least one variant. ITM_DECK_FLOOR appears in all 8 variants (always active). ITM_DECK_RAILING/SPINDLE in 4 variants. ITM_DECK_STAIR in 3 variants.

rule_3_sys_coating_type_match.notes: Material systems cover all 3 coating_type values (semi_transparent, semi_solid, solid_stain). Bonding primer correctly conditional on existing_coating_type. Prep chemicals conditional on existing_coating_condition.

rule_4_in_consumed.notes: All 13 IN_ inputs consumed by sop_modules or production tasks.

rule_5_ps_key_match.notes: All PS_ keys in production.json match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs.

rule_6_zone_id_match.notes: All 5 zone_ids match between spec.json and sop_modules.json protection_metadata.

rule_7_module_phase_order.notes: Phase order correct: setup -> prep (assess, floor, railing, chemical_restore) -> apply (floor, railing, stair) -> cleanup.

rule_8_uom_consistency.notes: UOM matches between sop_modules.json and production.json for all 43 tasks.

issues.description: Solid stain delamination risk on RP is documented as compounding (each coat adds film thickness) but no quantitative threshold is enforced by the engine. COMPAT-DKRP-004 mentions >10 mil DFT as strip trigger, but no task measures DFT. Assessment module checks adhesion (ASTM D3359) and condition, but DFT measurement is not a separate task.
issues.suggested_fix: Accept as documentation-only warning for v0.1.0. DFT measurement could be added as optional assessment task in future version. Estimator must flag solid-over-solid manually based on customer interview about previous coating history.
issues.resolution: Accepted as warning. Documented in RISK-DKRP-001.

issues.description: FAC_DKRP_EXISTING_CONDITION peeling modifier (2.00x) assumes standard multi-layer stripping difficulty. Decks with 3+ previous solid stain coats or epoxy-fortified coatings may require multiple strip cycles, exceeding the 2.00x modifier. Rate validation not yet performed for extreme stripping scenarios.
issues.suggested_fix: Flag for estimator review when existing_coating_condition=peeling AND existing_coating_type=solid_stain AND customer reports 3+ previous coats. Consider T&M recommendation for extreme stripping. Add validation plan item for multi-layer stripping rate calibration.
issues.resolution: Accepted as warning. Documented in risks. Validation plan includes multi-layer strip timing.

issues.description: Context prefix DKRP uses 4 characters while most existing prefixes use 4-5 (DECK, TRRP, CEIL, WALL). DKRP is unambiguous and collision-free but is a compressed abbreviation pattern not established by other RP specs (TRRP uses full context letters).
issues.suggested_fix: Accept DKRP — it is clear (DeckRePaint), collision-free, and 4 characters is within conventions. Alternative DKRP vs DECKRP — DKRP is preferred for task_id readability (TSK_DKRP_ vs TSK_DECKRP_).

issues.description: Clear_sealer is excluded from RP scope (RC-001) because it is classified as maintenance-only reapplication. However, a homeowner with an existing clear sealer that has failed (turned milky, peeled, or degraded) would need a restain workflow that starts with assessment and potentially stripping the failed sealer. This edge case falls into a gap between NC spec (no assessment) and RP spec (no clear_sealer).
issues.suggested_fix: Document as an edge case in spec notes. In practice, failed clear sealer is treated by the RP spec with existing_coating_condition=failing and target coating_type=semi_transparent (upgrade from clear to semi-transparent is standard professional recommendation for failed sealers). The exclusion is specifically for simple maintenance re-application of the same clear product.
issues.resolution: Accepted as documentation note. Failed sealer enters RP pathway via semi_transparent target coating.

con_prefix.notes: All consumables use CON_ prefix (never CONS_).

uom_uppercase.notes: All UOM values uppercase (SF, LF, EA, FIXED).
